articles.title: Why some Canadian companies are bringing captive risks home to Alberta
articles.summary: Hub International says Canadian firms are redomiciling captive risks from offshore to Alberta, citing flexible rules now allowing surety, lower premiums, and better tax outcomes than offshore captives taxed under FAPI.

articles.title: Piko Re targeting untapped captive reinsurance market
articles.summary: New captive-focused reinsurance intermediary Piko Re will target mid-sized single-parent captives and segregated cells, starting in the US with Canada flagged as a potential early expansion market.

articles.title: Captive owners find new ways to finance risks, manage losses
articles.summary: Vermont's captive regulator reports owners converting single-parent captives into sponsored captives to insure partner and joint-venture risks in segregated cells, a structure Canadian parents with Vermont captives may consider.

articles.title: Captive Insurance and Data Centers: Managing Risk in a Digital World
articles.summary: AM Best examines how captives can help data centre operators retain cyber, property, and business interruption risks, relevant as Canadian data centre construction scales into multi-billion-dollar projects.

articles.title: Could QJS unlock capital for Cayman and Guernsey captives?
articles.summary: Cayman's pursuit of NAIC qualified jurisdiction status could eventually lower US collateral requirements for captive reinsurers, though the initial phase covers only P&C reinsurers rather than most Class B captives.

articles.title: Lloyd's Establishes Framework for Broker-Originated Reinsurance Structures
articles.summary: Lloyd's new framework, effective January 1, 2027, sets capital, eligibility, and oversight rules for investor-backed broker-originated reinsurance structures and requires prior submission when captives participate.
